WORK_RESEARCH.intent: Study complete food works for focal scale, appetite, silence, rhythm and visual restraint.

RADAR.intent: Collect concrete meal moments with enough context to render a believable food state.

EDITORIAL.intent: Choose one sensory change or eating moment without forcing story-comic reversal or recipe exposition.

STORYBOARD.intent: Design food-state transitions, hands and utensils, focal areas and silent beats.

ASSET_PRODUCTION.intent: Bind actual meal and style references and render physically and culturally coherent food states.

COMPOSITION.intent: Keep lettering editable and protect the food focal area.

QC.intent: Check food state, contact geometry, meal context, sensory readability and lettering separately.
